messages:
alex-pm: Quick design call — we need a consistent model for saved views that works across org/team/route and keeps telemetry/quota attribution clear. Thinking inheritance + explicit namespace. Thoughts?
cheng-engineering: +1 on inheritance but worried about edge cases for rollouts. if a route overrides a model, what remains in the parent view? do we copy or reference?
maria-analytics: telemetry note: saved views must capture sampling settings and telemetry_namespace. otherwise metrics like p50 and cost-per-token will be inconsistent when viewed at team vs route scope.
sam-devex: UX idea: show a small breadcrumb like "Org > Team > Route (overrides 2 filters)" and an expand view to show what came from parent vs local edits. Keep default as reference (non-copy) to avoid drift.
acheng-engineering: we should expose an API field like `inherit_from` and a boolean `materialize_on_save`. default false. if materialize true we snapshot the query and telemetry config. that solves rollouts where parent changes mid-canary.
alex-pm: snapshotting seems safer for canaries+rollouts. but snapshotting increases storage and complexity for migrations. maybe only snapshot when the view is used in a rollout or pinned to a route?
maria-analytics: agree. Also require `telemetry_namespace` per saved view. Example payload: 
```
POST /api/v1/saved_views
{
  "name": "high-cost-models (team)",
  "owner_scope": "team:payments",
  "query": "route:checkout AND model:titan*",
  "inherit_from": "org:default-costs",
  "materialize_on_save": "conditional",
  "telemetry_namespace": "team.payments.routes",
  "sampling_rate": "0.05"
}
```
cheng-engineering: impl note: server must reconcile sampling when you expand a parent view to route-level. i.e., effective_sampling = parent_sampling * route_sampling_adjustment. we should store both explicit sampling and an origin flag so we can show in UI.
sam-devex: for permissions, saved views should have `can_share` and `visibility` (private/team/org). default team. and when inheriting, child cannot increase visibility beyond parent unless owner explicitly sets it — prevents accidental leaks.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for ui/saved-views-service change (PR #4221) — ETA 30m. :package:
alex-pm: ok next: quota attribution. when a saved view aggregates routes across teams, which team's quota gets charged in the console cost preview? proposal: when previewing at org scope show per-team breakdown, but any API action that executes a query should require an execution_scope param to decide billing.
maria-analytics: +1. Also add `cost_estimate` metadata cached per-view for fast UI display (recalc on mutate, stale-tolerance 15m).
cheng-engineering: final flag we need: `freeze_on_rollout` — if a saved view is attached to an active rollout, lock inheritance until rollout finishes. avoids noisy regressions.
alex-pm: great. action items: cheng to sketch API fields + migration plan, maria to list telemetry fields we need to persist, sam to mock UX micro-interactions for parent/child diffs. follow-up sync tomorrow. :calendar:
